name: Seti-Controler-3E2
comment: From Altium Gerbers in board-3E2/Gerbers (PCB1.GKO outline 2.000 x 2.000 in; 2 copper layers GTL/GBL). Mounting holes: two NPTH in PCB1-RoundHoles.TXT, drill 0.09606 in = 2.44 mm at (0.15, 1.85025) and (1.85, 1.85025) in, rounded to KiCad's 2.5 mm MountingHole size. Board thickness and surface finish are not in the Gerbers; 1.6 mm is an assumed default. Altium rules: clearance 6 mil, min track 6/8 mil, min annular ring 6 mil; no board-edge clearance rule given.
